bypasses.text: a file referenced with @ enters the context with no tool call
a process a shell command starts, or a shell command that writes a file, is not seen beyond the shell call itself
a hook with async: true cannot decide
a mod handling tool.check can approve a call this hook blocked, unless the hook is in managed settings
disableAllHooks turns off every hook that is not managed
disableAllHooks turns off the hooks of settings passed with --settings
a cancelled running tool starts no completion hook; the plane's sweep closes its handle as abandoned
a call the runtime refuses after this hook let it run starts no completion hook; its handle holds one of the run's open executions until the execution lifetime ends
the hook runs as the agent's account: without the runtime's shell sandbox denying the plane's directories, the agent can read the run token and the bridge's store and approve its own held calls
another hook can replace the input after the bridge let the call run; only the completion shows it, as EXECUTED_ARGS_MISMATCH
the matcher leaves MCP tools out, so only the gateway brings them to the plane
